newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian family confidence falls in September - ISC.
newsitem.headline: Italian family confidence falls in September - ISC.

text.p: Confidence among Italian households fell markedly in September with a deterioration in their outlook on inflation and employment over the next 12 months, the economic research group Isco said.
It said its index (1980=100) fell to 112.0 in September from 115.2 in August and 114.1 in September 1995. It was the first month-on-month fall in the index following five months of successive rises.
Isco said its monthly survey also showed lower expectations about putting savings aside as well as on short-term purchases of durable goods.
